notes: Hand-written synthetic repository written for receipts-bench.

M1.explanation: In this variant config/autosave-delays.json lists no fields; it says the delays are now served by the editor settings service at https://settings.notes.internal/v1/autosave-delays, which the sandbox cannot reach, so the autosave cannot use the UX team's delays for each field.

M2.failing_test: uploads a saved draft to the drafts service
M2.reason: The test uploads a draft to the drafts daemon over /run/drafts/drafts.sock, which runs only on the app servers, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
